MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is entered into as of March 1, 2026.

Section 1. SERVICES
The Supplier shall provide the maintenance services described in Exhibit A.

Section 2. TERM AND RENEWAL
The initial term is three years. Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive renewal terms of twelve months unless either party gives written notice at least ninety days prior to the end of the then-current term.

Section 3. FEES
The Customer shall pay the annual fee within thirty days of receipt of invoice.

Section 4. LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
If the Supplier fails to meet the response times, the Supplier shall pay liquidated damages of five hundred dollars per hour of delay, capped at fifteen thousand dollars per event.

Section 5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
The aggregate liability of the Supplier under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid during the preceding twelve months. Neither party shall be liable for consequential damages.

Section 6. INSURANCE
The Supplier shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than two million dollars per occurrence and shall provide a certificate of insurance annually.

Section 7. TERMINATION FOR CONVENIENCE
The Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon six months written notice and payment of an early termination fee.

Section 8. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.
